name: slow-drift
description: Normal range of head movement with a slow drift of 2° per minute at rest.
notes: Turn 25° left and right, up and down 12°: the awake default for 'normal range' (TUNE). The turn stays above 10°, so this profile does not count as small range. Drift 2° per minute (given), the most the slow-drift behaviour allows (2° per minute or less); the format holds the rate only, not the direction. Tremor 0 at 0 Hz (given: no tremor). Fatigue 0 (given: no fatigue). Dozing null (given: no dozing). Face loss null (given: the face stays in view). Seed 3503 set by the plan (task 3.5).
